metadata.description: Whitelabel Flutter app (Android + iOS) giving licensed kart drivers offline, corner-by-corner track guidance. Content, licenses and theming come from a multi-tenant Drupal central application (separate repo) over a REST API.
tech_stack: Platform channels: Android FLAG_SECURE, iOS secure text layer
metadata.repository: Flutter app only; Drupal central application lives in a separate repository (EXT-* features are tracked here as dependencies, not built here)

features.title: Flutter project scaffold
features.description: Create the Flutter project with go_router navigation, Riverpod, folder structure, lints and test setup. Portrait only, one app name and icon for all tenants.
acceptance_criteria: App builds and runs on Android and iOS
Portrait orientation locked
go_router routes exist for activation, first sync, track list, track, corner, settings and locked screens (placeholders)
Lints and `flutter test` run clean
Launcher icons generated from the ApexGuide app icon (app_icon, 1024 × 1024; see ISS-006)

features.title: Theme engine with light/dark and tenant color hook
features.description: Light and dark themes following the system setting with a manual override, plus a hook to inject tenant primary/secondary colors per mode.
acceptance_criteria: Theme follows system setting by default
Manual override (system, light, dark) persists across restarts
Theme accepts separate light and dark primary/secondary colors at runtime
Visual style matches the Claude Design prototype

features.title: English/Dutch localization scaffold
features.description: Localization setup for en and nl; follows device language with an override hook for Settings.
acceptance_criteria: All UI strings come from en and nl resource files
App follows device language for en/nl, falls back to en otherwise
Language can be overridden at runtime and persists

features.title: Encrypted local database
features.description: drift over SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers (DEC-010) implementing the schema in docs/database/mobile-erd.md. Database key generated per install, stored in Android Keystore / iOS Keychain (whenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly).
acceptance_criteria: All tables from the ERD exist with keys and ON DELETE CASCADE to TRACK
Database file is unreadable without the key
Key is generated on first launch and stored in Keystore/Keychain
Schema covered by tests against an in-memory database

features.title: API client and mock API
features.description: dio client for the /api/v1/ contract: bearer token interceptor, error mapping ({error, message}, 401, 403 revoked, 409, 426), server_time header capture, and a mock API implementing the frozen contract so app work is not blocked by Drupal.
acceptance_criteria: Typed models for all endpoint payloads in the spec
403 on any endpoint surfaces as a single 'revoked' event
426 surfaces as an 'update required' event
server_time from every response is stored
Mock API serves a demo tenant with one indoor and one outdoor track

features.title: Repository layer
features.description: Repositories over the database exposing tracks, corners, content, videos, favorites, theme and sync state to the UI via Riverpod.
acceptance_criteria: UI never accesses drift directly
Content queries filter by condition and language
Repositories are unit tested

features.title: Delta sync engine
features.description: On every start when online: tracks index, compare versions, fetch tracks/{id} for new or changed tracks, write each track in one transaction, delete tracks marked deleted or missing from the index. Runs the license-refresh and app/config steps first, theme refresh and feedback flush last.
acceptance_criteria: New, changed and deleted tracks handled correctly
Interrupted sync leaves the previous track version intact
403 during sync aborts and triggers the wipe
Unit tests against an in-memory database and fake API

features.title: Layout image download and encrypted storage
features.description: Download layout images and logo via media/{id} only when the checksum changed; store encrypted in the app sandbox; decrypt into memory on view.
acceptance_criteria: Unchanged checksum skips the download
Images on disk are not viewable without the key
Failed image download leaves the old track version intact

features.title: First-sync progress screen
features.description: Branded progress screen after activation showing track count, with retry on failure. Later syncs run silently behind the track list.
acceptance_criteria: Shows progress as tracks complete
Retry on failure without re-activation
Navigates to the track list when done

features.title: Installation id that survives wipes
features.description: Generate the installation id on first launch: app-scoped ANDROID_ID on Android, a UUID stored in the Keychain on iOS. It is the only item kept by a wipe.
acceptance_criteria: Same id returned across app restarts
Id survives the wipe routine
Id survives reinstall on Android; iOS Keychain persistence verified on a real device

features.title: Activation screen and activate call
features.description: Key entry screen (neutral publisher logo, language switch, privacy note) calling activate with key, installation id, platform and app version. Stores token, server time, tenant and theme, then starts the first sync.
acceptance_criteria: Key format: 4 groups of 4 characters, no ambiguous letters
Error states for unknown key (404), revoked (403), bound elsewhere (409) and offline
Token stored in secure storage, never in the database
Successful activation leads to first sync
Layout follows prototype screen 3a (ApexGuide logo, grouped key field, Activate as primary action); demo mode (LIC-006) and QR scan (UX-004) are Phase 2

features.title: License state machine
features.description: Daily refresh when online and last check is older than 24 hours (on start and on return to foreground); 7-day token max age; network failures ignored until exp; wipe when exp has passed or the device clock is earlier than the last server time.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests with a fake clock and fake API cover: bind, re-enter on same installation, refuse on another, refresh, expiry wipe, revocation, clock moved back, offline paths
Expired token wipes content but keeps the installation id
Re-entering the same key on the same installation restores access

features.title: Revocation handling and Locked screen
features.description: A 403 from any endpoint wipes local data and shows the key entry screen with the reason. Locked screen explains that the license expired and data was cleared.
acceptance_criteria: 403 from any endpoint triggers the wipe
Locked screen shows the reason (expired vs revoked)
Revoked key is refused on re-entry

features.title: Android FLAG_SECURE and disabled text selection
features.description: Platform channel setting FLAG_SECURE on the main activity at start-up; SelectionContainer.disabled around content; no share or copy actions.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots and screen recording show a blank/blocked screen on Android 12+
Corner text cannot be selected or copied

features.title: iOS secure text-field layer
features.description: Corner text rendered in a native UITextField with isSecureTextEntry as layer host, embedded via a platform view, isolated so it can be replaced by the blur fallback if iOS breaks it.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots and recordings show the corner text area blank on iOS 16+
Text not selectable
Implementation isolated in one platform view

features.title: Wipe routine
features.description: Delete database, image folder, Keystore/Keychain DB key, token and shared preferences; keep only the installation id; restart to key entry.
acceptance_criteria: After wipe only the installation id remains
App restarts on the key entry screen
Wipe covered by tests

features.title: Track list
features.description: Search by name, country filter chips, favorites first, indoor/outdoor badge, tenant logo in header.
acceptance_criteria: Search filters by name
Country chips filter the list
Favorites toggle locally and sort first
Indoor/outdoor badge shown

features.title: Zoomable layout viewer with corner hotspots
features.description: Layout image with pinch-to-zoom; corner numbers drawn at (x * width, y * height) with a minimum on-screen tap target of 44 px regardless of zoom. Built responsive for future landscape/tablet.
acceptance_criteria: Hotspots align with image coordinates at every zoom level
Tap target never below 44 px on screen
Tapping a hotspot opens the corner detail

features.title: Numbered corner list
features.description: Numbered corner list on the track screen, selection kept in sync with the layout viewer; videos row and feedback button placement.
acceptance_criteria: Corners listed in sequential order
Selecting in the list highlights the hotspot and vice versa

features.title: Dry/wet toggle
features.description: Toggle swapping layout image and content set; hidden for indoor tracks; selected corner stays selected.
acceptance_criteria: Toggle hidden for indoor tracks
Toggle swaps image and content
Selected corner is preserved across toggle

features.title: Corner detail screen
features.description: Condition badge, four sections in order (Approach, Braking zone, Apex / Turning point, Overtaking / Defending), previous/next corner, protected text rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Four sections shown in spec order
Previous/next navigation across corners
Text rendered through the protection layer on both platforms
Light-markdown content renders correctly

features.title: Tenant theme fetch, cache and apply
features.description: Theme from the activate response and tenant/theme (ETag/304), logo via media/{id}, cached and applied app-wide; primary drives app bar, toggle and hotspots, secondary drives accents and active corner.
acceptance_criteria: Theme applied immediately after activation
Refreshed on sync only when updated_at changed
Separate light and dark color sets applied per mode

features.title: Neutral native splash and branded start screen
features.description: Native splash stays neutral; Flutter start screen shows tenant branding once the theme is cached. Activation screen always uses the neutral publisher logo.
acceptance_criteria: Native splash identical for all tenants
Branded start screen shown only when a theme is cached
Activation screen never shows a tenant logo
Default splash follows prototype screen 2a (ApexGuide logo on white)
Branded splash follows prototype screen 2b (tenant logo, tenant-colored progress rule, 'powered by ApexGuide' at the foot)

features.title: Settings screen
features.description: Theme (system, light, dark), language (en, nl), license status and next check, app version, wipe and re-activate. No track-day switch in Phase 1; UX-001 adds it. In demo mode, LIC-006 adds the real-key activation entry. Derived from the App design section; added to the spec backlog (ISS-001).
acceptance_criteria: Theme and language overrides take effect immediately
License status and next check shown
Wipe and re-activate asks for confirmation
No track-day mode switch until UX-001 ships

features.title: Pilot builds: signed APK and TestFlight
features.description: Signed Android APK shared by link; iOS built and uploaded to TestFlight via a GitHub Actions macOS runner (the 2016 MacBook Pro cannot run Xcode 26).
acceptance_criteria: Signed APK installable from a link
macOS runner workflow builds and uploads to TestFlight internal group
Signing secrets stored as GitHub secrets, never in the repo
Apple Developer and Google Play accounts opened
Builds use the ApexGuide app icon from FND-001

features.title: YouTube clips at corner markers
features.description: Corner detail offers clip buttons per video marker for the current condition (or 'both'); opens the YouTube player at start and stops at end. Streamed only, never cached.
acceptance_criteria: Only markers for the current condition or 'both' are shown
Player starts at start_seconds and stops at end_seconds
Clear offline message when no connection

features.title: Feedback sheet with offline queue
features.description: Thumbs up/down plus optional text per track and condition (preselected from toggle); sent anonymously, or queued in FEEDBACK_QUEUE and retried on next start.
acceptance_criteria: Condition preselected from the toggle
Offline feedback queued and sent on next online start
No device or person identifier in the payload

features.title: Bound-elsewhere (409) message and binding reset flow
features.description: Clear 409 message telling the driver to contact the coach for a binding reset; same key works after reset.
acceptance_criteria: 409 shows a contact-your-coach message in en and nl
After a coach reset the same key activates on the new installation

features.title: Demo mode via shared demo key
features.description: 'Continue in demo mode' on the activation screen (prototype 3a) activates with a demo key built into the app. The key belongs to a server-side demo tenant whose key an admin has marked as allowed on many devices (DEC-009), so demo content can change without an app release. After that, the normal license, sync and wipe flows apply. Also serves as the Apple reviewer path for DST-002. Moved to Phase 1 (2026-10-05) to enable rapid testing.
acceptance_criteria: Demo mode button activates with the built-in demo key and leads to first sync
Demo content comes only from the demo tenant via the normal API; nothing is bundled in the app
DEMO marker visible while in demo mode; feedback is not sent to any club
Activating a real key from Settings wipes demo content first, then activates
Demo key is read from build configuration, not hardcoded in widget code

features.title: Track-day mode
features.description: Settings switch: base font one step larger, high contrast, screen awake on Track and Corner screens, enlarged previous/next controls for gloves.
acceptance_criteria: Screen stays awake only on Track and Corner screens
Larger type and high contrast applied
Previous/next controls enlarged

features.title: Updated badge
features.description: Badge on tracks changed since the driver's last visit, based on track version.
acceptance_criteria: Badge shown after a sync changes a track
Badge cleared when the track is opened

features.title: Minimum-version check and update screen
features.description: app/config check during sync and 426 handling; blocking update screen with the server message.
acceptance_criteria: App below min_version shows the update screen
426 from any endpoint shows the same screen

features.title: Scan QR code to activate
features.description: 'Scan QR code instead' on the activation screen (prototype 3a): scan a coach-provided QR code that holds the activation key, then use the normal activate flow.
acceptance_criteria: Scanning a valid code fills the key and starts activation
Camera permission asked only when the driver taps scan; denial falls back to typing
Coach license page can show a key as a QR code

features.title: Store listings and unlisted Apple distribution
features.description: Play closed testing then public listing; TestFlight external then unlisted App Store distribution; reviewer demo key and note, privacy policy URL, age rating for minors, screenshots in both modes.
acceptance_criteria: App available on Play and as unlisted App Store app
Reviewer demo key works against the demo tenant (the shared demo key from LIC-006 / EXT-011)
Privacy policy reviewed before submission

features.title: CI/CD pipeline with automated store uploads
features.description: GitHub Actions: tests on every commit, APK on Linux, IPA on macOS runner, uploads to Play internal and TestFlight. Extends the minimal iOS workflow from DST-001.
acceptance_criteria: Tests run on every push
Tagged builds upload automatically to both stores

features.title: Sentry crash reporting and maintenance calendar
features.description: Sentry for Flutter with no personal data in reports; maintenance rhythm from the spec documented.
acceptance_criteria: Crashes reported with no personal data
Alerts on new crash types
Maintenance calendar documented

features.title: [Drupal] Install, Group tenancy, content types, trackguide module skeleton
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository.
acceptance_criteria: Demo tenant exists with one indoor and one outdoor track

features.title: [Drupal] activate and license/refresh endpoints
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository. JWT (7 days) with tenant_id and key_binding_id.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints match the spec's API contract

features.title: [Drupal] Coach license pages: issue, list, reset, revoke
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository.
acceptance_criteria: Coach can issue, reset and revoke keys within their own group only

features.title: [Drupal] tracks, tracks/{id} and media endpoints
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository. Version = node revision id.
acceptance_criteria: Payload matches the spec's track shape; cross-tenant requests return 403

features.title: [Drupal] Coach track editor with coordinate picker
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository.
acceptance_criteria: Coach places corners by clicking the image

features.title: [Drupal] Translation workflow and publish validation
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository.
acceptance_criteria: Publishing blocked without both languages or without wet content on outdoor tracks

features.title: [Drupal] Coach video and marker editor
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository.
acceptance_criteria: Markers carry corner, start, end, condition and label

features.title: [Drupal] Feedback endpoint and coach feedback list
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository.
acceptance_criteria: POST feedback returns 201; list filters by track and condition

features.title: [Drupal] Theme endpoint and coach theme page
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository.
acceptance_criteria: tenant/theme supports ETag/304; coach preview shows both modes

features.title: [Drupal] app/config endpoint (minimum app version)
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository.
acceptance_criteria: Returns min_version and message

features.title: [Drupal] Demo tenant and admin override for multi-device keys
features.description: External dependency built in the Drupal repository. Platform admins (not coaches) can mark a key as allowed on many devices, overriding the one-key-per-installation rule (DEC-009). Used for the shared demo key of the demo tenant. Phase 1 because LIC-006 needs it.
acceptance_criteria: Only the platform admin role can set or clear the multi-device flag
activate with a multi-device key never returns 409
Demo tenant holds only content that is safe to show publicly
activate is rate-limited per installation for multi-device keys

phases_legend.inception: Feature has been identified but not yet planned
phases_legend.merged: Approved and merged to main branch

release_phases_legend.1: Pilot: everything the pilot needs on both platforms
release_phases_legend.3: Operational tooling; opens the future-release backlog
